ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate ~85% of visible surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (black) borders and basal insertion zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity region spanning both lobes. Low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge boundary. A vertical low-intensity pixel cluster is located at the fluke-to-peduncle insertion point. Sparse dark focal spots are mapped to the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 40 degrees with a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:3 within the central bounding area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the right lobe boundary. The left lobe boundary is interrupted at the distal tip by a high-relief, irregular cluster of multi-tonal pixels (brown/white/black).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory observed on the superior edges of both lateral lobes extending from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast cluster localized on the far-left fluke tip. Small, localized dark pixel clusters (mottling) observed in the lower-left ventral region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned low-contrast linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cluster of high-relief sessile organisms (barnacles) on the left distal tip. Irregular, non-symmetrical dark pigmentation patch at the basal insertion point.
